vetSays.line: 🛡️ Jayden, Roman, Emma, Danae and Amina met them at the door — 5 put down. Jayden, Roman, Emma, Danae, Amina are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Roman — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Roman chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
Roman shows you Cold-Blooded — not the power, just the shape of it. Watch and learn.
📓 Codex: you've SEEN Cold-Blooded now. You need 20% less food in cold weather. Your body budgets like an accountant.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Emma and Danae met them at the door — 2 put down. Emma, Danae are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jayden just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Roman just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emma just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jayden, Roman, Emma, Amina and Diana met them at the door — 5 put down. Jayden, Emma, Amina are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Giulia just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jayden just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Roman Ahn, 52 — a Mortician. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Cold-Blooded, Fusion Reactor, Feast Engine.

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jayden just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Danae just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Sasithorn and Mark met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Sasithorn, Mark are hurt.
🛡️ Sasithorn met them at the door — 1 put down. Sasithorn is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Beatriz taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Beatriz passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
